non_scope: AI Tool Engine, LLM tool definitions, Tool Registry, AI tool selection, tool input mapping from a model, tool result flow back to a model, tool_call parsing (NXS-P08 / NXS-TOOL-001)
Direct LLM access to external APIs or to plaintext secrets — architecturally forbidden

Concrete provider suites: Salesforce / HubSpot / Dynamics / SAP / Oracle / Odoo / Google Calendar / Microsoft Graph business logic — only the neutral adapter contract and a generic REST/OpenAPI adapter
OAuth2 interactive authorization-code flows and account-linking UI (deferred; only client-credentials where safely supported)
A production external secret vault — P07 ships the vault interface/seam and a local encrypted-at-rest implementation only
Channel providers: WhatsApp / email / SMS / telephony / ElevenLabs webhooks and delivery (NXS-P09+)
Metering, cost and billing of outbound calls (NXS-P23)
Full observability platform (NXS-P24) — P07 emits structured logs and metrics-ready fields only
Distributed circuit-breaker coordination and cross-node rate coordination beyond the bounded per-integration scope
Workflows, scheduler, campaigns, Sentinel, compliance, audit platform, resilience certification, DR, release and production deployment (later phases)
A generic public POST /http/request, arbitrary URL proxy, arbitrary GraphQL executor, arbitrary raw-header forwarding or arbitrary webhook forwarding endpoint
objective: Build the permanent provider-neutral Integration Hub: a tenant-owned Integration Registry with configuration-versioned Integrations, typed AuthProfiles that reference secrets indirectly through a credential-reference / vault seam (never plaintext, never returned, never logged), an operation-based execution model where a caller chooses integration_id + operation_key + validated input and never a raw URL, method, headers or query, a governed HTTP executor with bounded connect/read/total timeouts, request and response size limits, controlled redirects and TLS verification, mandatory SSRF destination policy enforced at BOTH configuration and execution time (localhost, loopback, link-local, cloud metadata, RFC1918, multicast, reserved ranges, non-http(s) schemes and DNS-to-private resolution all blocked; redirects revalidated), a safe bounded OpenAPI ingestion pipeline that extracts allow-listed operations without auto-exposing every endpoint, a governed GraphQL primitive that executes only registered documents with bounded variables/depth/response, provider-neutral CRM/ERP/Calendar adapter interfaces that still route through policy + credentials + SSRF + executor + schemas, safe retry classification (SAFE/IDEMPOTENT/NON_IDEMPOTENT) with bounded backoff and Retry-After, durable execution idempotency scoped by organization/integration/operation with request fingerprinting, a per-integration circuit breaker, bounded outbound rate limiting, an inbound webhook foundation with signature verification, replay window, durable dedup and trusted tenant mapping, untrusted response validation into a normalized IntegrationResult, a stable RFC 9457 error taxonomy, and P04 transactional events — proven by unit, integration, security (SSRF / secret exfiltration / cross-tenant / arbitrary-execution), concurrency, resilience and contract test matrices, reversible migrations with forced RLS and tenant-aware FKs, multi-architecture builds and a clean-room validation on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. The LLM never reaches a raw external API and never receives a plaintext secret.
title: Integration Hub
